connection.endpoint.label: Receiver service
connection.endpoint.description: SoapySDRServer address (tcp://host:port). The service and vendor API run separately from Foreshadow. Start the receiver service, then refresh devices.
connection.unavailable: No receiver is available from the receiver service. Check its address, start SoapySDRServer on the receiver computer, and verify that its SDRplay API and driver are installed. Then refresh devices.
